verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at https://ryzenai.docs.amd.com/llms.txt with real Ryzen AI Software content, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs for this chip's software stack. The per-page markdown docs endpoint returned 404, so support beyond the single index file is thin. Missing for 10: markdown versions of doc pages, any first-party documentation of the llms.txt offering, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
